lines.beaver: 이번 주말에 뭐 할래요? 같이 놀러 가요.
lines.beaver_en: What shall we do this weekend? Let's go out together.
lines.beaver_roman: Ibeon jumare mwo hallaeyo? Gachi nolleo gayo.
lines.en: Sounds good! Shall we go fishing?

lines.beaver: 낚시요? 저는 낚시를 한 번도 안 해 봤어요.
lines.beaver_en: Fishing? I've never been fishing before.
lines.beaver_roman: Naksiyo? Jeoneun naksireul han beondo an hae bwasseoyo.
lines.en: That's okay. Fishing is really fun.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Let's think of other hobbies too.

lines.beaver: 장난감 만들기는 좀 어려울 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: I think making toys would be a bit hard.
lines.beaver_roman: Jangnangam mandeulgineun jom eoryeoul geot gatayo.
lines.learner: 그럼 만화 카페에 갈래요? 만화가 가득 있어요.
lines.en: Then shall we go to a comic café? It's full of comics.
lines.roman: Geureom manhwa kapee gallaeyo? Manhwaga gadeuk isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 만화 카페 좋아요! 거기서 뭘 읽을 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: A comic café sounds great! What will you read there?
lines.beaver_roman: Manhwa kape joayo! Geogiseo mwol ilgeul geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 저는 만화 중에서 전기 만화를 좋아해요.
lines.en: Among comics, I like biography comics.
lines.roman: Jeoneun manhwa jungeseo jeongi manhwareul joahaeyo.

lines.en: It's King Sejong's biography. It's really fun.

lines.beaver: 와, 재미있겠네요. 낚시는 안 할 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, sounds fun. Aren't we going fishing?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, jaemiitgenneyo. Naksineun an hal geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 오전에 낚시하고 나서 만화 카페에 갈래요?
lines.en: Shall we go to the comic café after fishing in the morning?
lines.roman: Ojeone naksihago naseo manhwa kapee gallaeyo?

lines.beaver: 좋아요! 둘 다 즐길 수 있겠네요.
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo! Dul da jeulgil su itgenneyo.
lines.learner: 네, 주말 재미있게 보내요. 정말 기대돼요!
lines.en: Yes, let's have a fun weekend. I can't wait!
lines.roman: Ne, jumal jaemiitge bonaeyo. Jeongmal gidaedwaeyo!

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a fishing rod? I don't.
lines.learner: 저는 낚싯대가 두 개 있어요. 하나 빌려줄게요.
lines.en: I have two fishing rods. I'll lend you one.
lines.roman: Jeoneun naksitdaega du gae isseoyo. Hana billyeojulgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Then see you Saturday morning!
lines.learner: 좋아요. 점심 먹고 나서 만화 보러 가요!
lines.en: Okay. After lunch, let's go read comics!
lines.roman: Joayo. Jeomsim meokgo naseo manhwa boreo gayo!
